name: Newton log-concavity of elementary symmetric polynomials

insights: maclaurin_step follows from newton_log_concavity via a power inequality + rpow conversion
The power inequality aₖ^(k+1) ≥ aₖ₊₁^k is proved by induction using a division-free argument
Division-free key step: (aₖ₊₁²)^(k+1) ≥ (aₖ·aₖ₊₂)^(k+1) = aₖ^(k+1)·aₖ₊₂^(k+1) ≥ aₖ₊₁^k·aₖ₊₂^(k+1), then cancel aₖ₊₁^k
The zero case requires a structural property: for non-negative inputs, eⱼ = 0 implies eₖ = 0 for all k ≥ j
The rpow conversion uses: a^(1/k) = (a^(k+1))^(1/(k(k+1))) and rpow_le_rpow monotonicity
Finset.exists_smaller_set does not exist in Mathlib v4.26.0; use card_powersetCard + card_pos instead
pow_le_pow_left₀ is the correct API name for monotonicity of nat power on reals (not pow_le_pow_left)
